eekes_form_builder_mailchimp.title: Mailchimp
eekes_form_builder_mailchimp.subscribe_d: Adds the visitor to a Mailchimp audience, or updates them when they are already in it. The merge fields of the audience appear below once you pick it; fields of your own become merge fields too: "company" fills COMPANY.
eekes_form_builder_mailchimp.double_opt_: New subscribers first get an e-mail from Mailchimp to confirm.
eekes_form_builder_mailchimp.tags_help: Comma separated, e.g. website, contact form.
eekes_form_builder_mailchimp.status.step: Create an API key in Mailchimp under Profile → Extras → API keys.
eekes_form_builder_mailchimp.status.key_: The key has to end in its data center, like abc123-us21. Copy the whole key from Mailchimp.
